verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs and GitHub reference an observability system with tracing, metrics, logs, and traces (crewai-docs-11, crewai-docs-29, crewai-gh-2) and enterprise real-time monitoring/webhook streaming (crewai-docs-30, crewai-docs-31, crewai-docs-43), implying LLM call and tool invocation tracing in a UI. However, there is no first-party screenshot, detailed walkthrough, or independent hands-on confirmation of a UI showing per-call/tool traces. missing for 10: concrete UI screenshots or docs detailing per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation trace views, independent/third-party confirmation of the observability UI in practice.
